notes_for_editor: Only tnlandforms gives a code and a removal status; the Forest Lookouts page gives name and county only. The agency is left out of facts because no source names one, although the 2-19 code follows the state district-tower numbering that tnlandforms describes. The record's elevation 422.1 m matches 1,385 ft. The record's status 'gone' fits 'removed'. Nothing found on construction, design, staffing, fires or the site today, so the story is short (about 120 words) because the evidence does not support more. Searches: one per tower plus one shared search for the 1933-1975 MPDF, which gave no page text for this tower.
